candidates.label: Draft A (structured)
candidates.text:
Hi Jordan,

I'm sorry for the trouble with your invoice, and I understand how disruptive a billing error can be.

Here are the next steps we'll take to resolve this:

- I've flagged the duplicate charge for reversal.
- You should see the refund within three business days.
- I'll follow up personally once it clears.

Please reply if anything looks off, and I'll jump right back in.

candidates.label: Draft B (terse)
candidates.text: Refund issued. It will show up soon.

candidates.label: Draft C (wordy, no list)
candidates.text: Hello there and thank you so much for reaching out to us today about this particular matter. We are sorry to hear about the difficulty you experienced and we truly understand that these things can be frustrating for anyone in your position. Rest assured that our team is looking into everything carefully and we will make sure to follow up with you about the next steps as soon as we possibly can, because your satisfaction genuinely matters to all of us here on the support team every single day.
